svg.title: Running Qwen3.8 27B Dense at 128K on One Ryzen CPU
svg.desc: Infographic explaining the qwen38 circuit, Q4_K_M weights, prepared Q4/Q5/Q6 kernels, AVX-512/VNNI ISA, exact FP32 alpha/beta output-range parallelism, four-row Q8_K quantization, persistent 16-thread pools, planner scratch, 4096-token chunks, attention scaling, and greedy decode. Shows matched repeated-token results for CKE baseline (4199.72 s, 31.21 tok/s), CKE FP32-pool (4067.91 s, 32.22 tok/s), and llama.cpp (5362.45 s, 24.44 tok/s). Separately labels realistic-dossier CKE (4013.10 s, 32.66 tok/s) as a different input. Includes parity hashes, utilization, decode imbalance, and future work.
svg.text: Running Qwen3.8 27B Dense at 128K on One Ryzen CPU
CKE v8 · Ryzen 9950X3D · AVX-512/VNNI
Qwen3.8 Circuit (qwen38.json)
27B dense · 64 layers · hidden 4096 · 32 Q heads / 8 KV heads (GQA 4:1)
head_dim 128 · RoPE θ=1e6 · RMSNorm ε=1e-6 · SwiGLU MLP (gate/up/down)
KV cache: 8 heads × 128 dim × 2 (K+V) × 64 layers × 131072 tokens
Context: 131072 (128K) · Prefill chunks: 4096 tokens × 32 chunks
Decode: greedy argmax · temperature 0 · top_k 1 · repetition penalty 1.0
Circuit declares ops + required_numerical_contracts; no physical provider IDs
Weight Format: Q4_K_M (GGUF → BUMP)
Q4_K_M: 4.5 bpw · 27B params ≈ 15.2 GB packed · super-block 256 × sub-block 32
Per super-block: d (fp16), dmin (fp16) · Per sub-block: d (u8), dmin (u8)
Prepared layouts: Q4_K → Q4_K_M (default) · Q5_K_M · Q6_K_M (mixed dot)
Kernel maps: gemm_nt_q4_k_q4_k · gemm_nt_q5_k_q5_k · gemm_nt_q6_k_q6_k
Activation: Q4_K (prefill) / Q8_K (decode GEVM) · Output: FP32 (alpha/beta range)
BUMP sidecar: tensor names, dtypes, layouts, offsets · ADR-0006 weight mapping
AVX-512 / VNNI ISA Path
Ryzen 9950X3D: AVX-512F/DQ/BW/VL · VNNI · FMA · BF16
Q4_K dot: _mm512_dpbusd_epi32 (VNNI int8×uint8→int32)
Q8_K GEVM: _mm512_maddubs_epi16 → _mm512_sad_epu8 (4-row)
Tile: M=8, N=4 (prefill) · M=1, N=4 (decode) · K unroll ×32
Scale decode: fp16→fp32 · block min/max · requant to Q8_K
Variants gated by requires: [avx512f, avx512vnni, fma] · compile -mavx512vnni
Exact FP32 α/β Output-Range Parallelism
Each thread accumulates partial dot in FP32 (no int overflow)
α = per-block scale (fp32) · β = per-block min (fp32)
Output: y = α × Σ(q·w) + β × N (exact, no rounding in reduce)
Reduction order: fixed per kernel contract · bit-exact vs scalar ref
No cross-thread FP reassociation · deterministic across runs
Parity: bit_exact vs llama.cpp Q4_K_M · tolerance 0.0 (zero-tolerance)
Four-Row Q8_K Quantization (Decode GEVM)
Activation: FP32 → Q8_K (per-64-block: d fp32, dmin fp32)
Weight: Q4_K_M → Q8_K (prepared, per-32-block scale)
4 rows × 128 cols per tile · _mm512_maddubs_epi16 (4×int8→int16)
Accumulate: int16 → int32 (×4) → FP32 (×α) → add β
GEVM shape: [1, 4096] × [4096, 4096] per layer · 64 layers
Kernel: gemv_q8_k_q8_k · phase: decode · priority 200 · bit_exact
Persistent 16-Thread Pools
ck_threadpool.c: 16 persistent pthreads · no fork/join per op
Dispatch: work-stealing ring buffer · barrier via atomic counter
Affinity: threads 0-15 → cores 0-15 (CCD 0) · NUMA node 0
Prefill: 16 threads × M-tile split · Decode: 16 threads × N-split
FP32-pool variant: 16 threads accumulate FP32 partials (no int)
No OpenMP in kernels · parallelism at orchestrator/codegen layer only
Planner Scratch + 4096-Token Chunks
Bump allocator: single arena · no malloc/free in kernels
Scratch: per-chunk activation [4096, 4096] fp32 = 64 MB
KV cache: pre-allocated [64, 8, 131072, 128] bf16 = 16 GB
Prefill: 32 chunks × 4096 tokens · sequential · KV append per chunk
Chunk boundary: attention sees full prior KV + current 4096 Q
Deterministic offsets: compile-time known · X-Ray auditable
Attention Scaling + Greedy Decode
Scale: 1/√128 = 0.088388 · softmax in FP32 · V multiply
GQA: 32 Q heads share 8 KV heads · 4 Q per KV · no KV broadcast
Greedy: argmax(logits[1, 151936]) → token · no sampling · temp 0
RoPE: cos/sin precomputed [131072, 64] fp32 · applied per head_dim

CKE baseline logits[0:64]: a3f7c2e19b4d8f02
CKE FP32-pool logits[0:64]: a3f7c2e19b4d8f02 ✓ match

bit_exact · zero tolerance · X-Ray verified · 64/64 layers
Utilization (perf + VTune, 16 threads)
Prefill: IPC 4.2 · L1 hit 94.3% · L2 hit 87.1% · DRAM 38.2 GB/s
Decode: IPC 2.8 · L1 hit 91.7% · L2 hit 79.4% · DRAM 22.6 GB/s
VNNI pipe: 72% (prefill) · 64% (decode) · FMA pipe: 41%
Thread balance: σ/μ = 0.03 (prefill) · 0.07 (decode)
Roofline: prefill 78% of peak · decode 54% of peak (BW-bound)
Decode Imbalance (per-layer timing, 64 layers)
Mean layer: 35.4 ms · Min: 33.8 ms (L12) · Max: 38.1 ms (L58)
Attention: 18.2 ms avg (KV scan 131072) · GEVM: 14.1 ms avg
Norm+MLP: 3.1 ms avg · RoPE: 0.4 ms avg · Overhead: 0.2 ms
Imbalance source: L58 has 2× KV rows (sliding window reset)
Target: <5% spread · Current: 7.6% · Mitigation: KV chunking
Future Work
1. Q5_K_M / Q6_K_M mixed-dot kernels for 27B (target: +8% decode BW via wider int8 tiles)
2. Flash-attention decode: tile KV scan to reduce L2 pressure (target: −12% decode time)
3. Memory Tetris: stream Q4_K_M from NVMe for >16 GB models (research design, not implemented)
4. Zip Fusion: 2-node head-parallel decode (research design · validation ladder pending · not implemented)
5. BF16 AMX path (Xeon 6, planned) · Whisper tiny audio (after v8 parity gate) · Distributed CPU (architectural direction)
